newsitem.title: USA: April G7 forex statement impact welcomed - Japan.
newsitem.headline: April G7 forex statement impact welcomed - Japan.

text.p: Japan and the United States applaud the impact of the Group of Seven finance ministers April statement on currency markets, a Japanese official told reporters on Sunday.
The official said the United States and Japan shared the view that excessive volatility in foreign exhancge rates was undesirable.

"We understand that Japan and the United States both welcome the fact that the April G7 statement has penetrated into the market," said the official who accompanied Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka here to the G7 summit.
Mitsuzuka and U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin explained each others positions on Japan's trade surplus in their meeting last Friday, he said.
"We feel that the United States wants to see how Japan's external surplus will develop this year and next," the Japanese official said.
